name: XPlayer NodeDistributePlus permissionless DynamicBurnPool drains the XPL/USDT pair
summary: XPL.DynamicBurnPool moves XPL from the XPL/USDT PancakeSwap pair to DEAD and calls sync(), and is restricted to owner, staking, marketing and nodeShareAddress. nodeShareAddress is the NodeDistributePlus proxy, whose DynamicBurnPool(date, amount) forwards any caller's request within the day's burn cap with no caller check. The attacker bought almost all pair XPL with flash-loaned USDT, burned the day's remaining 3,078 XPL cap from the pair through NodeDistributePlus, and sold 57 XPL back against a near-zero XPL reserve for all pair USDT.
notes: Admin upgradeTo selected the NodeDistributePlus implementation whose DynamicBurnPool has no caller authorization (it also dropped the previous one-hour cooldown); it is the last Upgraded event before the exploit and the implementation the exploit trace delegatecalls.

Exact USDT depletion of the XPL/USDT pair 0x9b0ff36de2fc477cda8e4468e0067322ae18ce70 in the single exploit transaction. The attacker's 217,118,901.83 USDT swap inputs and the 239.5M USDT flash loans are returned within the transaction and netted out; the 245,744.20 USDT paid to flash lenders does not reduce gross depletion, so the loss exceeds the 718,844.12 USDT attacker profit reported by BlockSec. The pair's XPL loss (694,171.88 to 57.41 XPL) is the same liquidity and is not added.
